g.text: Energy is shown after each action.
At -20: energy before the first recorded action.
At 0: basal death, before movement or feeding.
was present before the actor paid basal cost.
Nearby food is not actual food intake.
Seven final survivors: nearby food did not guarantee intake
Campaign 019 / post hoc selection: all seven extinctions; 33 censored worlds excluded.
Tick relative to this individual's extinction (different absolute ages)
No birth or movement payment in these individual windows. This is not a causal rescue or sensory-advantage test.
